name: Flame tests, hydroxides, anion tests and instrumental analysis

terms.definition: Lithium crimson, sodium yellow, potassium lilac, calcium orange-red, copper green.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. A mixture can mask colours.

terms.definition: Sodium hydroxide gives: Al³⁺, Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺ white; Cu²⁺ blue; Fe²⁺ green; Fe³⁺ brown.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Aluminium hydroxide dissolves in excess.

terms.definition: Dilute acid gives carbon dioxide, which turns limewater milky.
Dilute nitric acid then silver nitrate: chloride white, bromide cream, iodide yellow precipitate.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Nitric acid removes carbonate ions first.

terms.definition: Dilute hydrochloric acid then barium chloride: white precipitate.
Accurate, sensitive and rapid, and work with very small samples.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Flame emission spectroscopy identifies ions and their concentrations.
